title: 2 ConStory-Bench
use_cases: Use when evaluating the long-form narrative consistency of large language models
Implement when categorizing narrative errors into fine-grained taxonomies
Configure when setting up an automated LLM-as-judge pipeline for story validation
Use when benchmarking a model's ability to maintain world-building and characterization integrity
content:
We present ConStory-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating consistency in long-form narrative generation. The benchmark uses an LLM-as-judge pipeline to detect consistency errors and classify them into fine-grained categories. Section 2.1 describes the data collection and prompt construction procedure, Section 2.2 introduces the error taxonomy, and Section 2.3 presents the automated evaluation pipeline.

Figure 2: Representative consistency error examples sampled from real LLM-generated stories on ConStory-Bench. Highlighted segments show contradictions in Timeline & Plot Logic, Characterization, World-building & Setting, Factual & Detail Consistency, and Narrative & Style.
